promises.label: Execute multiyear share repurchases
promises.commitment: Implement a new $30 billion multiyear share-repurchase program authorized in April 2025.

promises.commitment: Reach 100% tokenization of Visa e-commerce transactions globally; no completion deadline was specified.

promises.label: Launch live agentic-commerce pilots
